hypothesis: The actual native AdamW step may overshoot its training objective or worsen structural assignment on other training events. A single prespecified half-step comparison tests this, rather than transferring the convex-probe optimizer result to the scientific model.
initialization: Exact frozen Phase76 context-on downstream-final model, decoder and optimizer state. Every counterfactual resets to this same state; historical run is never resumed or changed.
audit_population: 96 existing training events,16/category ranked SHA256(phase77-gradient:UID), matching the prior deterministic gradient cohort. No validation/test. Record overlap with optimizer minibatches.
updates: 12 independent native one-step minibatches of8 events drawn sequentially from the saved sampling RNG state; no chained fitting. For each native parameter delta, compare the full delta with exactly0.5 delta from the same initial state. This is one prespecified step-scale contrast, not a grid.
measurements: raw exact memberships,event counts and fixed acceptance
optimizer step norm,gradient norm and source/checkpoint integrity
paired collision changes on non-minibatch audit events,category/size and background controls
decision: A learning-rate intervention requires consistent actual-model overshoot and structural/background evidence across prespecified minibatches; loss-only or tiny-only improvements do not select a study. Otherwise reject that mechanism and record the specific remaining evidence limit. No heldout cohort consumed for this diagnostic.

budget.checkpoint_selection: all prespecified endpoints,none selected by validation

constraints: Corpus,widths,geometry,normalization,PID,source/charge constraints unchanged; native objective/gradient clipping/Adam state. All generated outputs detector-only and detached before label joins. No production-model claim or automatic page update.
